_comment: Event Lineage parameters. All values are initial heuristics (starting points from the PRD), not validated facts. Changing any value changes config_hash, which is stored on every link. Kept outside data/knowledge_base so it does not alter the knowledge-base version hash.

eligibility._comment: Run statuses whose graph is usable. PARTIAL = graph persisted but an optional step (e.g. explanation) degraded. exclude_simulated_runs drops runs produced by the mock LLM (mode SIMULATED) even for non-simulated events.

similarity._hub_comment: Hub nodes appear in many events. They still contribute to cosine similarity (down-weighted by hub_weight and by IDF) but never count as informative shared nodes, so they cannot create a link on their own. Ids are knowledge-base canonical ids.
similarity._cold_start_comment: When fewer than cold_start_min_events eligible events exist, IDF is unreliable: hub nodes are then dropped from the vectors entirely (hub_weight treated as 0), the static prior being the hub list above.

impact._comment: I_e = clip(mean(top_k path scores) / s_ref, 0, 1). Path scores share one bounded formula across events (geometric mean of edge scores x length decay x direction factor), so they are comparable rankings, NOT probabilities. s_ref placeholder ~ upper range of observed path scores.

category_half_life_days._comment: Placeholder half-lives mapped onto the existing EventType values. single company: 7, central bank: 14, commodity/energy supply: 21, war/geopolitics: 30. Other categories are explicit placeholders.
